profile.name: Ali Alouane
profile.role: ML/AI Engineer · GenAI, Robotics & Physical AI
intro: I build **generative AI that ships**: LLMs, RAG and agentic systems, taken from first prototype to production.
Outside my day job, I build robots that learn: I’m teaching a self-built robotic arm to see and act with **vision-language-action models**.
profile.quote: AI is the next industrial revolution. I want to help steer it toward the most good, for the most people.
profile.status: Open to AI Engineering roles · Berlin, Germany
profile.motto: Move fast on evidence. Move carefully on power.
about: I'm an **ML/AI Engineer** who takes generative AI from a whiteboard idea to a system real users depend on. My focus is **LLM applications**, **retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)**, and **agentic, multi-agent systems**, plus the evaluation, guardrails, and LLMOps that make them trustworthy in production.

Currently I'm building LLM platforms at [ITUC GmbH](https://www.ituc.de). Before that I co-founded the edge-AI startup **ROVEONE**, and I was the first ML engineer at **truemetrics (YC S23)**, shipping time-series ML on AWS. This year our agentic systems won [1st place at the InnoTrans 2026 Hackathon](#projects).

Outside my day job, I'm building a robotic arm from scratch, from the motors and electronics up, and teaching it to handle objects on its own with **vision-language-action (VLA) models**: it learns first by copying demonstrations (imitation learning), then improves by trial and error (reinforcement learning). More in [Physical AI](#lab). In my free time I fly racing drones, build small self-driving cars, run, and train karate.
